$comment: Source files that contribute ZERO measured statements, so they sit outside every coverage
[absent] no test imports the file, so v8 never instruments it and it is missing entirely.
[empty]  the report lists the file with an empty statement map.
Neither is reported as 0%. Untested code here is invisible rather than failing, which is the
inverse of what a coverage gate is for. `search` reported 56.49% over 848 statements while
its 1303-line filters drawer counted for nothing on either side of that fraction.
`files` is dated debt: real code that no test reaches. An entry is a record that the file is
untested and a date by which that stops being acceptable — not permission to leave it so.
`noStatements` is a permanent exemption for files with nothing to measure; it is self-policing,
because an entry whose file starts producing statements is reported stale.
REGENERATED 2026-08-25 from fresh reports. The previous hand-authored version was built from
stale artifacts in coverage/ and nine of its eighteen adf-hx-bridge entries were wrong on the
day they were written — it listed hxql-literal.ts as having no in-project spec while
hxql-literal.spec.ts sat beside it, committed in a0528ab. The gate now refuses to read a
report older than the sources it describes, so that cannot recur silently.
